title: Conditional κ = 0.00310458 (+1.7454e-7, +0.0056223% over #5627): paid A2 rank exchange
body:

The extra ordinary ADD is charged; all 743 arbitrary inputs, 12,958 complete productive targets, endpoint frames and owned COPY/INIT/CLEAR instructions are retained.

The local paid change is `H2 + H6 − H3 − H5`, repeated across 18 local invocations. Strict concavity makes this a strict moment gain for every exponent in `(0,1)`. Two exact rational moment engines enclose the unique raw crossing in **(0.00310458658556, 0.00310458658557)**, leaving about **6.58556e-9** above the claim. Complete paid calls and rank-mass surplus remain 66,546 and 760.
